title: Smoke remaining minimal in Colorado, for now
snippet: We have seen improved air quality here in Colorado due to decreased fire behavior from in-state fires, and less transport of smoke from out-of-state. We are quite pleased to have this break from the smoke. However, we want to remain aware of the conditions that could affect us, even if this is not expected to happen immediately.
